props.label: Firm
props.description: Firm release types - generally are ship schedules which have been confirmed by the customer, to be shippable.

props.label: Forecast
props.description: Forecast types are generally those that extend for some period beyond the firm ship schedules - usually about 30-60 days - they are generally NOT shippable types - until customer service has converted these (or via edi) to a firm release.

props.label: Planning
props.description: Planning releases - are generally those that extend far beyond the allowable forecast time frame. For example, if your firms are out 2 weeks and forecasts are out 30 days beyond that, then your planned orders would 'start' around the 45 day mark (from now) and go out as long as necessary for planning purchases/production/etc.
